name: VisitMO.com Tourism Listing
eligibility: Tourism-related Missouri businesses, attractions, activities, services, products, and events that meet VisitMO criteria.
notes: Official Missouri Division of Tourism listing portal. Entries are reviewed and approved by MDT.

name: Arkansas.com Tourism Profile
eligibility: Arkansas tourism businesses and organizations eligible for an Arkansas.com industry account.
notes: Arkansas Tourism says eligible businesses can create and manage a free profile and see referral performance.

name: Arkansas Biz Connection
eligibility: Eligible Arkansas business owners receive one free business listing.
notes: Useful broad Arkansas citation for OzarkRoost and eligible Ozark businesses.

name: Ozark Area Chamber / Locable Directory
eligibility: Businesses and nonprofits can participate; local criteria may apply through participating organizations.
notes: The program states participation is free and supports local directory, offers, coupons, jobs, events, and community promotion.

name: Mountain Home Evolution Business Directory
eligibility: Businesses serving Mountain Home, Bull Shoals, Norfork, the White River, and surrounding Arkansas Ozark communities.
notes: The site currently advertises free basic business listings with paid featured/premium upgrades.

name: Best Lake Attractions
eligibility: Local Lake of the Ozarks businesses that fit the directory categories.
notes: The current listing page explicitly offers a $0 free listing with business details, category placement, website, directions, and one image.

name: Go Local 417
eligibility: Local businesses in the covered area; the directory currently emphasizes highly rated businesses.
notes: The current advertising page lists a free basic listing and paid premium placement.

name: BizHwy Free Business Directory
eligibility: Business owners or employees submitting legitimate business information.
notes: Broad citation opportunity. Use only for legitimate OzarkRoost business/brand profiles and avoid duplicate submissions.

name: Pulaski County Tourism Bureau Partner Listing
eligibility: Tourism-related businesses meeting the bureau's partner requirements.
notes: The bureau currently describes complimentary website listings and free listings for lodging, attractions, and outfitters; confirm eligibility before submission.
